item.title: U.S. Judge rules FCC violated ABC's free speech rights to please Trump
item.description: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration from moving to review all local broadcast licenses held by ABC. The stations air in six of the largest U.S. markets.

item.title: In a flash, the Army blew up nearly 5 tons of a degraded explosive at its plant in Iowa
item.description: The controlled detonation of more than 60 barrels of unstable lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown is complete. The explosive had been stored at the plant for nearly 20 years.
item.content:encoded: The controlled detonation of more than 60 barrels of unstable lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown is complete. The explosive had been stored at the plant for nearly 20 years.

item.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia leaves U.S. voluntarily for Spain
item.description: Abrego Garcia, a Salvadoran immigrant who became a symbol of Trump's mass deportation campaign, voluntarily left the country on Tuesday after nearly two years of legal battles.

item.title: These deer walk 300 miles a year. The race is on to save their migration
item.description: Mule deer in Wyoming make some of the longest land migrations in the lower 48 states. They're trying to adapt to a changing climate, but growing development could stand in their way.
